description: This file contains unit tests for the CanvasActionTrust class, testing URL trust validation logic.

classes.name: CanvasActionTrustTest
classes.description: A test suite for the CanvasActionTrust class, verifying URL trust acceptance and rejection conditions.

methods.name: acceptsBundledScaffoldAsset
methods.description: Tests that a URL representing a scaffold asset is recognized as trusted.

methods.name: acceptsTrustedA2uiPageOnAdvertisedCanvasHost
methods.description: Tests that a specific trusted A2ui page URL is accepted.

methods.name: rejectsDifferentOriginEvenIfPathMatches
methods.description: Ensures URLs with a mismatched origin are rejected even if the path matches a trusted URL.

methods.name: rejectsUntrustedCanvasPagePathOnTrustedOrigin
methods.description: Verifies that untrusted page paths on a trusted origin are correctly rejected.

methods.name: acceptsFragmentOnlyDifferenceForTrustedA2uiPage
methods.description: Checks that URLs differing only by fragment identifier are accepted if the base URL is trusted.

methods.name: rejectsQueryMismatchOnTrustedOriginAndPath
methods.description: Confirms URLs with query parameter mismatches are rejected despite matching the origin and path.

methods.name: rejectsDescendantPathUnderTrustedA2uiRoot
methods.description: Ensures URLs pointing to descendant paths outside the trusted root are rejected.
